name: Robert Ault
tagline: Top rated DUI-DWI attorney in Bellevue, Washington
about: Rob Ault is a partner at Veitch Ault Defense, located in Bellevue, Washington. He devotes his practice to defending those accused of criminal charges and focuses on the defense of DUI and other serious traffic offenses. Mr. Ault has received specialized training in many subjects relating to DUI, including blood draw analysis and DUI drug recognition investigation. He is also qualified under NHTSA standards to administer roadside field sobriety tests and is one of only a limited number of Washington State DUI defense attorneys who have successfully completed the NHTSA Advanced Roadside Impairment Driving Enforcement (ARIDE) course. Rob is a graduate of the National College of DUI Defense's Summer Session held at Harvard Law School and appears regularly in superior, district, and municipal Courts throughout Puget Sound, where he is known as an aggressive and skilled advocate. His vast experience, tireless work ethic, and attention to detail in each and every one of his cases routinely leads to favorable resolutions for his clients. Rob's status as one of the premier DUI defense lawyers in the state includes being recognized as both a Super Lawyer (2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016) and a Rising Star (2015, 2014, 2012, 2012).
